title: Make the optimizer easy to use and integrate
description: Native provider-neutral APIs, documented offline workflow and client integration; no DSPy. Completion includes usable prediction/feedback/optimization APIs, inspectable actual prompts/replies/tool calls and active classifier versions, verified via decision-flywheel-e1e92986-a121-410a-b8c2-fb467d6b3d88. Do not equate an optimize-save-decide component walkthrough with a working feedback loop.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Accountability: this was an assistant-authored scope error, not a stale external requirement. DSPy is explicitly excluded; the epic now covers only native, provider-neutral optimization.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Added explicit optional LiteLLM optimizer transport alongside the existing OpenAI default. Shared scorecard setting optimizer_transport is validated, frozen into new runs, retained through run-definition registration, and exposed in the scorecard editor. Native optimization, full-context request/response/tool-call tracing, failed-attempt ceilings, and zero SDK retries are preserved. Non-OpenAI environment credentials participate in trace redaction. Offline specs: 765 Python and 107 UI pass; build passes. Browser editor inspected and canceled without production writes. Server restarted only after idle check and SQLite backup; feedback 255, replay labels 765, events 39405 unchanged. Actual installed SDK smoke exposed an incomplete pre-existing LiteLLM package; repair and real-SDK offline smoke are in progress. No paid model calls or experiment reports.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Deployment follow-up: repaired the incomplete installed LiteLLM 1.103.1 distribution using its official PyPI wheel. Real LiteLLM completion with explicit mock_response and local model-cost map passes through the adapter without a provider call. Trusted-LAN server PID 48374 is running on port 8782; browser reload succeeds with no console errors. No production definition edits, labels, events, or jobs changed. Broader provider/live acceptance remains open.
